preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= N <= 100000 and 1 <= M <= 100000 for N, M in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, lengths N and M are between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c in '?abcde' for c in S) for S in test_cases)
preconditions.description: String S contains only characters from the set {'?', 'a', 'b', 'c', 'd', 'e'}.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c in 'abcde' for c in A) for A in test_cases)
preconditions.description: String A contains only characters from the set {'a', 'b', 'c', 'd', 'e'}.

preconditions.expression: sum(N for N, _ in test_cases) <= 300000 and sum(M for _, M in test_cases) <= 300000
preconditions.description: The sum of N and the sum of M over all test cases do not exceed 3*10^5.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly T lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all((len(line) == N and all(c in 'abcde' for c in line) and not is_subsequence(line, A)) or (line == '-1' and not exists_valid_S_prime(S, A)) for line, (N, M, S, A) in zip(output_lines, test_cases))
postconditions.description: For each test case, if a valid S' exists, the output line is a string of length N containing only 'a'-'e' such that A is not a subsequence of it; otherwise, the output is '-1'.
